A: first vertex of the nondegenerate triangle ABC
B: second vertex of the nondegenerate triangle ABC
C: third vertex of the nondegenerate triangle ABC
X: an arbitrary point in the plane of triangle ABC
P: the proposed or assumed common point of the three cevians
x: first normalized affine barycentric coordinate relative to ABC
y: second normalized affine barycentric coordinate relative to ABC
z: third normalized affine barycentric coordinate relative to ABC
alpha: the affine coefficient st/q of A in P
beta: the affine coefficient (1-s)(1-t)/q of B in P
gamma: the affine coefficient t(1-s)/q of C in P
t: the side parameter determined by D=(1-t)B+tC
ABC: the nondegenerate triangle with vertices A, B, and C
x_A: barycentric coordinate of X at A
x_B: barycentric coordinate of X at B
x_C: barycentric coordinate of X at C
d_B: the normalized barycentric coordinate of D at B
d_C: the normalized barycentric coordinate of D at C
e_A: the normalized barycentric coordinate of E at A
e_C: the normalized barycentric coordinate of E at C
f_A: the normalized barycentric coordinate of F at A
f_B: the normalized barycentric coordinate of F at B
p_A: barycentric coordinate of P at A
p_B: barycentric coordinate of P at B
p_C: barycentric coordinate of P at C
(ABC): the nondegenerate triangle with vertices A, B, and C
AD: the line through A and D
BE: the line through B and E
CF: the line through C and F
XY: for points X and Y, the positive Euclidean length of segment XY
q: the positive scalar 1-s+st used in the proof
(x,y,z): the normalized barycentric coordinates of a point with respect to triangle ABC
BD: Euclidean length of the segment from B to D
DC: Euclidean length of the segment from D to C
CE: Euclidean length of the segment from C to E
EA: Euclidean length of the segment from E to A
AF: Euclidean length of the segment from A to F
FB: Euclidean length of the segment from F to B
u: the side parameter determined by F=(1-u)A+uB
v: a real affine parameter locating P on BE
w: a real affine parameter locating P on CF
BD/DC: the ratio of the positive Euclidean lengths BD and DC
CE/EA: the ratio of the positive Euclidean lengths CE and EA
AF/FB: the ratio of the positive Euclidean lengths AF and FB
lambda: a real line parameter for AD
mu: a real line parameter for BE
nu: a real line parameter for CF
